config.name: dark_constraint_q7_eqhvd04
config.written: 2026-11-27, before running; new config for EXP-HVD-04 (sims/dark_constraint/config.json untouched)

kinds.brace: hidden spring on an antipodal pair, unit stiffness, rest length ref*(1+s) (the repo's dark brace)
kinds.tether: hidden spring, unit stiffness, pulling vertex i toward V0[i] + s*u_i, u_i a fixed unit vector tangent to the sphere

config.visible_residuals: per seed, r_vis ~ N(0, 0.03^2) per visible edge (rng seed 5000 + seed); present in the observed truth in BOTH arms, so the strength-0 arm exercises the fit

prediction.k_ge_2: Spearman rho(strength, residual) >= 0.5 and residual >= 3x floor at the largest strength
prediction.falsified_if: K >= 2 residual flat in strength (rho < 0.5) once the null is non-degenerate
